evidence.summary: Shenzhen University hosts the co-equal Shenzhen branch of the national defence science and technology key laboratory for precision guidance and automatic target recognition (ATR), which CASI describes as headquartered at the PLA’s National University of Defense Technology; the branch’s own site dates it to April 2001.
items: ATR Defense S&T Key Laboratory (精确制导自动目标识别国防科技重点实验室), Shenzhen branch (ATR国防科技重点实验室智能信息处理分室)

evidence.summary: CASI reports that the Shenzhen branch was set up as a joint project of the PLA General Armament Department and the Shenzhen government.
